title: PastPort blind independent visual rematch — full 39-target inventory

coordinate_system.accuracy: Approximate visual anchors, generally within tens of pixels for close distinct items and less precise for distant/occluded items; no calibrated localization error is claimed.

permitted_inputs: output/matching_database/modern_objects.csv (target IDs/names; notes treated only as hypotheses)
method.inspection: Every source photo was inspected individually. Both complete panoramas and original-resolution detail crops were inspected; one in-memory seam reconstruction was used. No prior review, saved coordinates, database, build script or rationale was read.
method.identity_policy: Exact object identity requires matching visual form plus distinctive neighboring geometry. Continuous assemblies receive representative anchors for visible sections. Components retain separate anchors. Category resemblance and uncertain candidates are not confirmed exact appearances. Scene 2 seam fragments are not counted as separate doors.
method.appearance_policy: Appearances list independently confirmed visible regions in each supplied scene. A continuous surface has representative anchors, not a pixel-by-pixel enumeration. Empty appearances mean not independently located, not rejected or proven absent.
method.scope: Only this report and its JSON counterpart were created; no application data or existing artifacts were modified.

revisions: The first-pass rounded estimates for previously identified primary targets are retained. Newly separated components receive their own anchors rather than inheriting a group coordinate.
The laptop support and wireless mouse are now separately anchored after closer inspection; this refines the previous setup-level match.

Source Photo 05 belongs to the staircase-end Crane B; it is not the same crane/hook as Photos 01/12/16. Both referents are explicitly retained under the affected inventory rows without falsely merging them.
Source Photo 13 tree and Photos 12/16 tree are distinct objects. Both first-pass tree estimates are retained as separate referents, while the inventory same-tree hypothesis is flagged.
The side planted trough in Photo 15 and end trough in Photo 01 have separate visible segments; their physical continuity is not established.
No previous abstention for Photo 17 shoes or its unique floor cover has been promoted to an exact object match.
